title: PagingOfFolderSummary
description: Specify paging and sorting options for querying records and returning results

batchCount.description: Number of result batches available with current query options

hasNext.description: Whether there are any results in additional pages

hasPrev.description: Whether there are any results in previous pages

nextSkip.description: Correct value of 'skip' for the next page of results

pageCount.description: Number of result pages available with current query options

prevSkip.description: Correct value of 'skip' for the previous page of results

skip.description: Number of records to skip before taking results

take.description: Maximum number of records to include in results

FolderSummary.description: Representation of a secret folder object

folderPath.description: The path of all folders and subfolders beginning at the root anterminating at this folder.

folderTypeId.description: The icon to display for the folder. Depricated in latest UI. Use 1 when setting this value.

inheritPermissions.description: Whether the folder should inherit permissions from its parent (default: true)

inheritSecretPolicy.description: Whether the folder should inherit the secret policy.  Defaults to true unless creating a root folder.

parentFolderId.description: The ID of this folder's parent folder.

secretPolicyId.description: The id of the Secret Policy that sets security and other settings on secrets contained within the folder.

Sort.description: Sort options. Multiple sort options can be provided in the query string.

priority.description: Priority index. Sorts with lower values are executed earlier
